title: Chris Zukowski picked my game as GAME OF THE YEAR - wtf (Scope Creepers Podcast)
author: Living-Inspection582
selftext:
So a crazy thing has happened the last couple of days.

In the Podcast "Scope Creepers", Chris Zukowski was on, and he started the podcast by talking about my game [https://inkdom.io](https://inkdom.io), and picking it for his Game Of The Year.

Long story short - a couple of days ago my game SPIKED LIKE CRAZY and I got all these new players in the game.

The community on the game messaged me everywhere, telling me that I've been attacked by bots. And I kept looking at the servers, trying to find out what was going on.

I couldn't. There was no sign of bots or anything. Everyone looked like normal players. 

But I had no idea where they came from.

And as a Solo Dev, you KNOW that players aren't just comming to your game out of the blue. Lol.

The next morning it continued. So many players signing up.

And then all of a sudden I saw players writing about that they came from an Podcast.

This was the Scope Creepers podcast. Where Chris Zukowski, talked about how he's been playing my game.

I'm in complete shock.

And also complete nerve-wrecking experience. Since so many players are joining the game.

Shout out to Chris. Shout out to Scope Creepers Podcast.

What an crazy fun experience to hear someone with the experience as Chris, talk about my small stupid game.

The Podcast episode: [https://youtu.be/iOt6NuMHlJc?si=bb5ARk-W3nQqGH\_f&t=77](https://youtu.be/iOt6NuMHlJc?si=bb5ARk-W3nQqGH_f&t=77)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Living-Inspection582 could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.

comments.author: aicis
comments.body: It's funny, because less than half a year ago he was telling to avoid AI in gamdev like a plague.
